newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybean offers mostly up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybean offers mostly up.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis offers rose on Wednesday in many positions, lifted by transportation problems on the upper Mississippi River, dealers said.
High water levels on the upper Mississippi continued to hinder barge traffic. In Minneapolis-St Paul, Minn., very few barges have been loaded to due floodwaters, one dealer said.
"Supply is down to the bare bones," he said.
He noted it would be at least two to three weeks before barge traffic comes back to normal on the Mid-Mississippi.
